model_fragment_what_this_is: q4km-mmproj-free-speech-native-np4-base-speech-query-prefix-max64 with decoding_params.max_tokens raised from 64 to 1536 and NOTHING else: the same GGUF, the same featcache build 04ccc72a, the same packet root and decoder hash, the same -np 4 / -c 65536 server args, the same batch and cache flags, the same prompt order, the same greedy temperature 0 seed 20260803 and the same per-sample slot affinity.
model_fragment_why_1536: EVO-S1's PROPOSER contacts return a whole scenario's rewritten blocks, which run to about 1,100 tokens on iot (nine intents); the preregistration fixes the ceiling at 1,536 (section 5 and configs/experiment/slurp-evo-s1-proposer-v1.json shared_protocol.max_tokens). The reward cells keep 64, unchanged from KC-S1b, so the two halves of the cell need two model fragments: decoding_params lives in the model fragment and core.config.compose refuses the same key from two fragments. rails.evolution.LoopConfig.proposer_model_fragment is the field that names this one; EVO-A1 leaves it absent and both its halves keep flying one fragment.
model_fragment_speech_keys_are_inert_her: speech_feature_root and the two LLAMA_SPEECH_* server_env entries are carried verbatim so this fragment is a one-key derivation of the reward fragment rather than a rewrite, but the construction-proposer-text arm carries no speech_feature_parts field at all (contracts.identifiers.ARM_VISIBLE_FIELDS), so FlightRuntime.uses_speech_feature_packets() is false, no packet binding is built, no promotion receipt is read and no audio part is ever sent.
